title: Doc Tests and API Tests
goal: Write executable documentation comments and integration tests.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Documentation Tests

sections.text: In Rust, code examples inside documentation comments double as executable tests. The test runner compiles and runs them automatically.

sections.caption: Doc comments use three slashes and triple backticks for code blocks.

sections.text: Doc tests act as external consumers of your crate API. They can only call items marked `pub`.
Attempting to call a private function inside a doc test fails with compiler error `E0603`.

sections.caption: Integration test files in tests/ can only access pub API items.

sections.text: Place integration tests in a root `tests/` directory. Use internal `#[cfg(test)]` modules for private implementation details.

explanation: Write executable documentation comments and integration tests.
